rootCauseAnalysis.flawCondition: if (tag === 'img' || role === 'img') triggered on <svg role='img'> elements
rootCauseAnalysis.mechanism: When an SVG specifies role='img', Rule 1 matched before Rule 6 (SVG Context Resolver). Rule 1 expects an 'alt' attribute, which native SVGs do not use (SVGs use child <title>/<desc> or ARIA). Missing 'alt' attribute caused Rule 1 to flag RULE_IMG_ALT_MISSING despite computed accessible name being valid ('Official Chart').
rootCauseAnalysis.remediation: Restrict Rule 1 matching to HTML elements or non-SVG role='img' elements: tag === 'img' || (role === 'img' && tag !== 'svg'). All SVG tags are directed to Rule 6 (Context-Aware SVG Resolver).
